orientation: higher: +1; lower: -1; multiply every adjacent and endpoint delta by orientation
task_weighting: Each task once; source report equal-slice native mean, only if every slice succeeds
missing_policy: Incomplete, never zero; partial trajectories not assigned full four-point shapes
strict_sensitivity: All four models numeric and line-compliant on every slice
inference: No p-values, confidence intervals, statistical-equivalence or randomness labels. Generation replicates and independent biological units differ by task. Source cohorts overlap across categories.
retrospective: Trajectory and diminishing-gain analyses selected after seeing results; exploratory. Nine monotonic tasks are not nine independent confirmations of a scaling law.
provenance: Final usability uses explicit historical repair overlay. API/Codex wrappers, reasoning controls and repair histories differ. First-attempt and observed-data sensitivities retained.
